meta.purpose: 기준 인물을 먼저 생성하고, 정면·반측면·전신 기준컷을 저장한 뒤 동일 인물을 여러 농산물 장면에 반복 사용하는 사이트 구성안

core_policy.main_rule: 장면 이미지를 먼저 만들지 않고 기준 인물 마스터 세트를 먼저 만든다.
core_policy.identity_rule: 장면 생성 시 저장된 대표 얼굴, 좌우 45도 얼굴, 반신 또는 전신 이미지를 함께 참조한다.
core_policy.realism_rule: 광고 모델처럼 완벽한 얼굴보다 자연스러운 비대칭, 피부결, 주름, 작업복 질감을 우선한다.
core_policy.storage_rule: 생성 서비스의 임시 URL만 저장하지 않고 원본 이미지를 자체 스토리지에 영구 저장한다.

prompt_engine.base_prompt_template: Create an original fictional {nationality_prompt} {gender_age_prompt}. He has {body_type_prompt}. Hair: {hair_prompt}. Outfit: {outfit_prompt}. Face and mood: {face_impression_prompts}. Realism: {realism_prompts}. He must look like a real agricultural produce worker, not a celebrity, actor, fashion model, influencer or synthetic advertising character. Use natural documentary photography, true-to-life color, moderate optical depth of field, ordinary photographic imperfections and realistic proportions.
prompt_engine.view_prompt_template: {base_prompt} View requirement: {view_prompt_addon}. Keep the same facial structure, hairstyle, age, skin tone, body build, outfit and overall identity across all generated views.
prompt_engine.identity_lock_template: Use the uploaded master reference images of the same fictional person. Maintain exactly the same face, facial proportions, eye shape, nose, mouth, jawline, hairstyle, hairline, apparent age, skin tone and body build. Do not redesign, beautify, reinterpret or replace the identity. Only change the requested action, pose, camera framing and environment.
prompt_engine.negative_prompt: plastic skin, waxy face, porcelain skin, excessive skin smoothing, beauty retouching, perfect facial symmetry, celebrity look, fashion model posing, influencer aesthetic, artificial smile, oversized eyes, exaggerated jawline, bodybuilder proportions, spotless clothing, glossy advertising finish, cinematic fantasy lighting, orange and teal grading, excessive HDR, excessive saturation, artificial bokeh, oversharpening, CGI, 3D render, game graphics, warped hands, extra fingers, fused fingers, duplicated limbs, floating objects, duplicated produce, repeated fruit patterns, random text, unreadable logos
